name: Tsubasa College
description: Tsubasa College is an editorial aircraft maintenance college WordPress theme designed for licence-track academies and aviation technical colleges. Built with Fraunces and Source Sans 3 typography, it features a focus-pull hangar hero, a horizontal 18-month curriculum ruler, an isometric module overview, and clean fee ledgers. The theme emphasizes clarity, technical precision, and practical workshop learning in a calm, professional design.
